title: Reader
says: A brief whole: the way down to it, its title and prose, the parts its prose places, and its parts beneath as a list of mounts.

title: Face
says: A brief seen from above: its number, its title and its first paragraph.

title: Holon
says: Any holon nothing closer draws, the wildcard: what it is an instance of, and every value it holds, each reference the face of what it points at.

title: List
says: A list of holons, each item a mount of its own, numbered where the whole that opened it numbers its parts.

title: Type
says: A type: what its instances are, each field it declares with what it means and its shape, and its instances.

title: Field
says: The field itself, the root: its stores, the names each gives, and every type it holds.
